statement: Explain how applying computational thinking to fundamental concepts is used to approach and solve problems in computer science.
guidance_bullets: Computational thinking does not necessarily involve programming—it is a toolkit of available techniques for problem-solving.
Real-world examples may include software development, data analysis, machine learning, database design, network security.
